commands.name: db > anim to json
commands.comment: Uses the Level / DB / Clip dropdowns and the reload_baked.json path.

commands.name: do change and bake in maya json
commands.command: echo MANUAL STEP in Maya: load "{baked_json}", edit, bake, then save as "{edit_json}"
commands.comment: Manual step. Just prints the paths to use.

commands.name: patch clip > modded anim
commands.comment: Writes the modded anim into Modding_project\pfguns_anim_mod\levels\<level>\<db>\ (same file name as the clip). The scratch db is only a by-product.

commands.name: build db from pfguns_anim_mod
commands.comment: Packs EVERY modded anim in pfguns_anim_mod (all clips you edited) into a fresh copy of the original db.

commands.name: copy db to game
commands.comment: COPY of the built modded db to <game>\levels\<level>\fpguns\<db name>
